verdict.rationale: Exit waterfall modeling is a fair axis for a cap table and equity management platform, but the evidence pack never mentions waterfall analysis, exit-value scenarios, liquidation preferences, or participation. The closest items are generic 'model equity ownership' wording and 'scenario planning' in the investor portal. Neither documents per-class or per-stakeholder exit proceeds, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run exit waterfall analyses showing proceeds per share class and stakeholder under different exit values, honoring preferences and participation
